entries.0688e68fe39b2a76: A business in which CoreBrain Co., Ltd., a consolidated subsidiary (100% of voting rights owned), performs a series of operations for internet sales, including order receipt, packaging, shipping, delivery, payment collection, customer management and handling of inquiries. It undertakes part of the fulfillment operations for the company's internet sales.
entries.09f174f02bdb467a: Ski and snowboard equipment. Net sales for the fiscal year ended August 2025 were ¥3,112 million (composition ratio 5.2%). This is a product category the company has handled since its founding.
entries.451c393a7c3f3b98: Outdoor equipment, including trekking gear, camping gear and outdoor apparel. Net sales for the fiscal year ended August 2025 were ¥8,177 million (composition ratio 13.5%). Trekking equipment remained firm, but the recovery in demand for camping equipment was slow, and sales fell below the previous year.
entries.8a2bf27b907ef63d: Golf equipment, including golf clubs, apparel, shoes, caddie bags and measuring devices. Net sales for the fiscal year ended August 2025 were ¥10,055 million (composition ratio 16.6%). Small items performed well, but golf apparel was affected by the weather, and overall sales fell below the previous year.
entries.a4025f465f17a62d: Products other than the above product categories. Net sales for the fiscal year ended August 2025 were ¥1,037 million (composition ratio 1.7%).
entries.c2a1c49b310c9dbc: A retail group that operates the sporting goods specialty store "Himaraya" at 101 stores nationwide and through online sales, selling general sporting goods, golf and outdoor goods and more.
entries.d9c5a182baa45af4: The core business of the group, which consists of the company, one consolidated subsidiary (CoreBrain Co., Ltd.) and one non-consolidated subsidiary (HIMARAYA USA,INC.), is the General Retail Business, a single segment. It operates the sporting goods specialty store 'HIMARAYA' nationwide, and as of August 31, 2025, it had 101 stores. The company sells sporting goods and related products, while its consolidated subsidiary CoreBrain Co., Ltd. undertakes part of the fulfillment operations for the company's internet sales.
entries.e195bd4ad3913401: General sporting goods, including apparel, footwear and equipment. Net sales for the fiscal year ended August 2025 were ¥38,064 million (composition ratio 63.0%). Demand related to school club activities remained firm, and running shoes and town shoes performed well.
